title: NFCPS One Scripture Lens update
notes: Keeps the original cinematic NFCPS Watch experience and adds the new native Scripture Lens underneath it. Lens no longer depends on YouTube captions: on supported Android devices it listens to capturable sermon playback, transcribes speech locally on the phone, and sends only recognized text to the existing NFCPS sermon-intelligence service to surface matching KJV passages and progressively learn the sermon. If direct playback capture is blocked, Lens can fall back to speech recognition.
